messages:
zoe: deploy-bot put prod-candidate promotion on HOLD — artifact integrity check failed for api-service-3.0.0.tar.gz. deploy-bot: "verify mismatch expected sha256=dd77aa...ef got sha256=88cc44...10". Do we pin to last-known-good or try a reupload?

liam: checking publisher logs. seeing multipart copy timeout on mirror-a around 10:02 UTC. origin object on s3-master matches expected dd77aa...ef.

noah: smoke tests show tar extract EOF and checksum mismatch; points to truncated replica. reupload changes object metadata which breaks immutability policy — prefer pin.

zoe: agree pin to last-known-good to avoid changing provenance during change window. open a ticket to investigate mirror multipart retry and post-replication verification.

deploy-bot: PROMOTE_HOLD: reason=artifact-checksum-mismatch, candidate=88cc44...10, last_good=dd77aa...ef, triggered_by=pre-prod-smoke. awaiting manual_approve from zoe.

liam: queued a quick sha check across origin and replicas; will confirm divergence ranges.

ci-bot: artifact-verify rerun (no rebuild) queued. result: replica mirror-a returned bad bytes for range 2MB-3MB. origin matches dd77aa...ef.

noah: filing ticket INF-2599: mirror multipart stall + missing post-replication checksum verify. assigning to infra team.

zoe: /deploybot approve promote prod-candidate --sha=dd77aa...ef --reason "pin last_known_good to keep change window"

deploy-bot: ACK. manual approval received. executing promote.

liam: manual promote complete, canary smoke green. deploy-bot: PROMOTE_COMPLETE prod-candidate -> sha256:dd77aa...ef :white_check_mark:

zoe: release note blurb: "Prod-candidate promotion pinned to previously verified artifact due to mirror replication inconsistency; origin artifact unchanged. Investigating mirror multipart reliability (INF-2599)."

noah: follow-ups: add post-replication checksum in publish pipeline, run mirror consistency scan for last 24h, and keep auto-promote disabled for artifacts until fix.

liam: will monitor alerts and block auto-promotes until INF-2599 resolved.

zoe: thanks everyone. closing thread once INF-2599 is live in Jira.
